newsitem.title: GERMANY: Results of Bundesbank poll, January 7. [CORRECTED 16:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Results of Bundesbank poll, January 7. [CORRECTED 16:30 GMT]

text.p: Following are the results of a poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this week's Bundesbank council meeting. The poll was conducted on Tuesday.
1. Will the Bundesbank cut its leading interest rates this week?
Yes 0
No 10
2. Will there be a further cut in the discount and lombard rates later this year?
Yes 1 (corrects from Yes 0)
No 9 (corrects from No 10)
3. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.0 pct this Thursday?
Yes 10
No 0
Detailed results of the poll as follows:
Economist 1. 2. 3.
Stephen Lewis, London Bond Broking No. No. Yes.
Ulrich Beckmann, Deutsche Bank No. No. Yes.
Kit Juckes, Nat West Markets No. No. Yes.
Armin Kayser, SBC Warburg No. Yes Yes.
(Corrects to show that Armin Kayser answered yes to question 2.)
Keith Edmonds, IBJ International No. No. Yes.
Norbert Meissner, Caisse de Depots No. No. Yes.
Klaus Baader, DMG London No. No. Yes.
David Brickmann, Yamaichi Int.Europe No. No. Yes
Ulrike Kastens, TCM No. No. Yes
Nikolaus Keis, Bayerische Vereinsbank No. No. Yes.
